name: Keywords AI
description: Keywords AI is a powerful tool designed to help businesses and marketers optimize their content for search engines by providing intelligent keyword suggestions and analysis. It leverages advanced AI algorithms to identify the most effective keywords that can enhance visibility and drive traffic to websites.

events.d: The Logs List endpoint allows you to get the past logs with specified filters.
You can create a prompt by sending a POST request to the prompts endpoint.
This endpoint retrieves log threads based on specified filters and pagination parameters.
You can update a prompt by sending a PATCH request to the prompt endpoint
You can delete a prompt by sending a DELETE request to the prompt endpoint.
You can create a prompt version by sending a POST request to the prompt versions endpoint.
This endpoint allows you to get a list of versions of a prompt.
